stable.notes: A loaded company or label printer profile stays loaded: Load stores it at once, Cancel no longer loses it, every start loads it.

beta.notes: Tools → Matrix (one wire per row, a column per node); Harness → Protection: Tape or Heatshrink + best fit for the whole harness; segment protection labels and notes in View Settings → Visibility; the title block on the canvas at the board's lower-left, printed there; docks open on the right; fixed: each wire shows its own net, canvas edits mark the project unsaved, Parts Database Reload.
